title: 超高層電梯分區與調度~Elevator zoning and dispatch in supertall buildings
focus: 以尖峰人流、分區轉乘、曳引極限與派梯演算法，讓超高層垂直運輸在有限核心筒內達到服務目標~Peak demand, tiered zoning, traction limits and dispatch algorithms that let supertall vertical transport meet service targets within a limited core
summary: 從上行尖峰人口與五分鐘運輸能力出發，說明超高層為何以穿梭電梯、空中大廳與疊用井道分段服務，再處理數百公尺行程的鋼索自重與曳引、超高速車廂的耳壓與振動、核心筒縮短下的導軌安裝、目的樓層派梯與往返時間計算，最後談鋼索擺動、維護更新與緊急運轉，並以哈里發塔、上海中心大廈與台北 101 的公開資料對照。~Starting from up-peak population and five-minute handling capacity, explain why supertall towers serve their floors in tiers with shuttles, sky lobbies and stacked shafts, then handle rope self-weight and traction over hundreds of metres, ear pressure and vibration in ultra-high-speed cars, rail installation on a shortening core, destination dispatch and round-trip-time calculation, and finally rope sway, maintenance, modernisation and emergency operation, compared with public data from Burj Khalifa, Shanghai Tower and Taipei 101.

units.title: 尖峰交通需求與服務指標~Peak traffic demand and service metrics
units.mechanism: 超高層辦公塔的電梯不是依平均使用量設計，而是依早上上班的上行尖峰：數千人在約一小時內從大廳湧入，各自前往不同樓層。設計者先由樓層淨面積、每人使用面積與出勤率估算各分區人口，再以「五分鐘運輸能力佔人口百分比」與「平均間隔」描述系統能否吸收尖峰；現代評估也加入午餐雙向交通、平均候梯時間與到達目的地時間。超高層的特殊之處在於人流必須經由轉乘，任何一段運輸不足都會在空中大廳形成排隊。~Elevators in a supertall office tower are sized not for average use but for the morning up-peak, when thousands of people arrive at the lobby within about an hour and head to different floors. The designer first estimates each zone's population from net floor area, area per person and attendance, then describes whether the system can absorb the peak through the five-minute handling capacity as a percentage of population and the average interval; modern assessments add two-way lunchtime traffic, average waiting time and time to destination. What makes supertall towers different is that people must transfer, so a shortfall in any one leg forms a queue in the sky lobby.
units.model: 分區人口 = 樓層數 × 淨面積 / 每人面積 × 出勤率。取 15 層、每層淨面積 1,500 m²、每人 10 m²、出勤率 80%：每層 1,500/10×0.8 = 120 人，分區人口 15×120 = 1,800 人。若目標為五分鐘運輸 12%，需 HC5 = 0.12×1,800 = 216 人/5 min，相當於 216/300 = 0.72 人/s。數值為教學假設。~Zone population = floors × net area / area per person × attendance. With 15 floors, 1,500 m² net per floor, 10 m² per person and 80% attendance, each floor holds 1,500/10×0.8 = 120 people and the zone holds 15×120 = 1,800. A 12% five-minute target needs HC5 = 0.12×1,800 = 216 persons per 5 min, or 216/300 = 0.72 persons/s. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計階段依 ISO 8100-32 或 CIBSE Guide D 的方法同時做計算與模擬並互相比對；入住後以大廳閘門刷卡紀錄、派梯系統登錄資料或人工計數，取尖峰最忙五分鐘的實際到達率，與設計假設的人口與百分比比較，若差異超過約兩成就重新檢討分區或派梯設定。~At design stage, run both the calculation and the simulation methods of ISO 8100-32 or CIBSE Guide D and compare them; after occupation, take the busiest five-minute arrival rate from lobby turnstile logs, dispatch-system call records or manual counts, compare it with the assumed population and percentage, and revisit zoning or dispatch settings if they differ by more than about a fifth.
units.failure: 租戶改為高密度開放辦公或共享辦公後，每人面積由 10 m² 降到約 7 m²，人口增加約四成，原本合格的分區在尖峰時大廳排隊延伸到門外、候梯時間倍增，只能錯開上班時間或改裝派梯系統補救。~When tenants switch to dense open-plan or co-working layouts, area per person drops from 10 m² to about 7 m², population rises by roughly 40%, and a zone that once passed sees lobby queues spill outside at peak and waiting times double, leaving staggered hours or a dispatch retrofit as the only remedies.
units.misconception: 電梯數量只要依全天平均搭乘人次決定就足夠。~The number of elevators can be set from the average number of rides over the whole day.
units.practice: 在設計基準文件中寫明人口密度、出勤率、尖峰百分比與間隔目標，並請業主確認未來租戶型態；分區人口要逐區列表，作為日後改租或改用途時的比對基準。~Write population density, attendance, peak percentage and interval targets into the design basis, ask the owner to confirm expected tenant types, and tabulate population zone by zone so it becomes the reference whenever leasing or use changes later.

units.anchor: 空中大廳轉乘層~Sky-lobby transfer floor
units.title: 分區、空中大廳與井道疊用~Zoning, sky lobbies and stacked shafts
units.mechanism: 若每部電梯都從地面直達服務樓層，越高的分區就有越多井道穿過下方樓層，核心筒會吃掉大量可出租面積。超高層因此把建築分成數個高區段，以大容量直達穿梭電梯（常為雙層車廂）把人送到空中大廳，再轉乘區間電梯；上段的區間電梯可以疊在下段區間電梯的同一井道位置上，讓同一片核心面積被重複使用。原世界貿易中心雙塔即以 44 與 78 樓空中大廳把每棟分成三段。~If every elevator ran from the ground to its served floors, higher zones would send more shafts through the floors below and the core would consume a large share of lettable area. Supertall towers therefore split the building into tiers: high-capacity express shuttles, often double-deck, carry people to a sky lobby where they transfer to local elevators, and the upper tier's local cars stack in the same shaft positions as the lower tier's, so the same core area is reused. The original World Trade Center towers used sky lobbies on floors 44 and 78 to divide each tower into three tiers.
units.model: 上半部 45 層若由 3 組各 6 部電梯從地面直達，下半部 45 層每層都要讓 18 個井道通過：18×45 = 810 井道·層；改為 6 部穿梭電梯到空中大廳、區間電梯疊用井道後只剩 6×45 = 270 井道·層。每井道取 8.4 m²，節省 (810−270)×8.4 ≈ 4,536 m²，約三層 1,500 m² 標準層。數值為教學假設。~If the upper 45 floors were served by three groups of six cars running from the ground, 18 shafts would pass through each of the lower 45 floors: 18×45 = 810 shaft-floors. With six shuttles to a sky lobby and stacked local shafts only 6×45 = 270 shaft-floors remain. At 8.4 m² per shaft the saving is (810−270)×8.4 ≈ 4,536 m², about three 1,500 m² typical floors. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以核心筒樓層平面逐層統計井道、機房、緩衝坑與轉乘大廳面積，計算核心效率（淨出租面積除以總樓地板面積），並與交通模擬得到的轉乘排隊長度一起比較不同分區方案，確認空中大廳的候梯面積能容納尖峰時的轉乘人數。~Count shafts, machine rooms, pits and transfer lobbies floor by floor on the core plans, compute core efficiency (net lettable over gross floor area), and compare zoning options together with the transfer queue lengths from traffic simulation, confirming that each sky lobby has enough waiting area for peak transfers.
units.failure: 空中大廳的轉乘動線若太窄，或穿梭電梯與區間電梯的停靠位置相距太遠，尖峰時往上轉乘的人流與往下的人流交錯，大廳變成瓶頸；穿梭電梯能力不足時，上段區間電梯再空也送不上人。~A sky lobby with narrow transfer routes, or with shuttle and local landings far apart, makes rising transfer traffic cross downward traffic at peak and becomes a bottleneck; if shuttle capacity is short, empty local cars in the upper tier cannot be filled no matter how many there are.
units.misconception: 分區越多、每區電梯越少，核心筒面積就一定越省。~More zones with fewer elevators each always means a smaller core.
units.practice: 空中大廳應設計成與雙層車廂對應的上下兩層並以手扶梯連接，保留足夠候梯面積與無障礙轉乘路線；分區界線樓層要避開避難層與機電層，或把它們整合在同一轉換段。~Design the sky lobby as two stacked levels matching double-deck cars and linked by escalators, keep enough waiting area and an accessible transfer route, and place zone boundaries clear of refuge and plant floors or integrate them within the same transfer tier.

units.anchor: 曳引鋼索與補償索~Hoist and compensation ropes
units.title: 鋼索自重、曳引與行程極限~Rope self-weight, traction and travel limits
units.mechanism: 曳引式電梯靠鋼索與曳引輪槽間的摩擦傳力，車廂側與配重側的張力比不得超過 Euler–Eytelwein 關係 e^(fα)，否則鋼索打滑。行程很高時，鋼索本身的重量變成移動質量的主角：車廂停在底層時，車廂側懸掛整段鋼索，張力比迅速放大，所以要在車廂與配重底部掛補償索平衡；但鋼索加補償索的總重又推高馬達、煞車與建築載重。這是超高層多以轉乘分段而非單段直達的主要原因之一，輕量的碳纖維帶狀曳引索則把這個限制往外推。~A traction elevator transfers force by friction between ropes and sheave grooves, and the ratio of car-side to counterweight-side tension must not exceed the Euler–Eytelwein limit e^(fα) or the ropes slip. At large rises the ropes' own weight dominates the moving mass: with the car at the bottom landing the full rope length hangs on the car side and the tension ratio grows quickly, so compensation ropes hang below car and counterweight to balance it; yet ropes plus compensation then load the motor, brake and building. This is one of the main reasons supertall towers use transfers rather than single-run travel, while lightweight carbon-fibre belt ropes push that limit outward.
units.model: 車廂 6,000 kg、額定載重 2,000 kg、8 條鋼索每條 0.9 kg/m、行程 500 m，鋼索重 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg。車廂在底層時車廂側 6,000+2,000+3,600 = 11,600 kg；配重 6,000+0.45×2,000 = 6,900 kg。無補償索時張力比 11,600/6,900 ≈ 1.68，大於 f = 0.1、α = π 的 e^(0.1π) ≈ 1.37，會打滑；加 3,600 kg 補償索後為 11,600/10,500 ≈ 1.10。靜態估算，數值為教學假設。~With a 6,000 kg car, 2,000 kg rated load and eight ropes of 0.9 kg/m over 500 m, rope mass is 8×0.9×500 = 3,600 kg. With the car at the bottom the car side carries 6,000+2,000+3,600 = 11,600 kg and the counterweight is 6,000+0.45×2,000 = 6,900 kg. Without compensation the ratio 11,600/6,900 ≈ 1.68 exceeds e^(0.1π) ≈ 1.37 for f = 0.1 and α = π, so the ropes slip; adding 3,600 kg of compensation gives 11,600/10,500 ≈ 1.10. Static estimate; values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依 EN 81-20 與 EN 81-50 的計算方法檢核裝載、緊急煞車與車廂受阻三種曳引條件，並核對鋼索安全係數；現場以超載試驗與緊急煞車試驗確認不打滑，再用鋼索張力計逐條量測張力，偏差過大須調整。~Check the three traction conditions of loading, emergency braking and stalled car with the calculation methods of EN 81-20 and EN 81-50 and confirm the rope safety factor; on site, confirm no slip in overload and emergency-braking tests, then measure each rope's tension with a rope-tension gauge and adjust when the spread is excessive.
units.failure: 各條鋼索張力不均時，受力最大的鋼索與其輪槽磨耗最快，輪槽變形後曳引能力下降，可能在緊急煞車時打滑；補償索導輪或拉緊裝置卡滯，車廂高速停止時會產生跳動與異常衝擊。~Uneven rope tensions wear the most heavily loaded rope and its groove first; a deformed groove loses traction and may slip during emergency braking, while a jammed compensation sheave or tensioning device makes the car bounce and jolt when it stops from high speed.
units.misconception: 只要換更大的馬達，單段行程就能無限提高。~A bigger motor alone lets single-run travel grow without limit.
units.practice: 鋼索規格書應列出直徑、構造、最小破斷荷重、安全係數與張力均勻允差；補償索要配置拉緊導輪與防跳裝置，並把鋼索伸長後重新截短的程序寫入保養計畫。~The rope specification should list diameter, construction, minimum breaking load, safety factor and tension-equalisation tolerance; compensation ropes need a tensioning sheave with an anti-rebound device, and the procedure for re-shortening stretched ropes belongs in the maintenance plan.

units.anchor: 車廂氣壓與主動導靴~Cabin pressure and active guides
units.title: 超高速車廂：耳壓、振動與導軌~Ultra-high-speed cars: ear pressure, vibration and rails
units.mechanism: 速度超過約 10 m/s 後，限制乘坐品質的不再是馬達，而是人耳與車廂動態。大氣壓隨高度降低，快速升降時中耳來不及平衡而產生耳塞感，超高速電梯因此以送風機控制車廂內氣壓變化率，並把車廂做成流線型膠囊以降低風切噪音。導軌接頭錯位與彎曲在高速下會轉成橫向振動，需以感測器與致動器構成的主動導靴抵銷。下降時耳壓較難平衡，所以廣州周大福金融中心的電梯上行 1,260 m/min，下行只有 600 m/min。~Above roughly 10 m/s, ride quality is limited not by the motor but by the human ear and car dynamics. Air pressure falls with height, so in a fast ascent or descent the middle ear cannot equalise and feels blocked; ultra-high-speed elevators therefore use blowers to control the rate of cabin pressure change and streamlined capsule cars to reduce wind noise. Rail joint offsets and bends turn into lateral vibration at high speed, which active roller guides cancel with sensors and actuators. Descent is harder on the ears, so the Guangzhou CTF Finance Centre elevators rise at 1,260 m/min but descend at only 600 m/min.
units.model: 壓力變化率 dp/dt = ρ·g·v。取 ρ = 1.2 kg/m³、v = 16.8 m/s：dp/dt = 1.2×9.81×16.8 ≈ 198 Pa/s ≈ 2.0 hPa/s；上升 382 m 的總壓差 ρgh = 1.2×9.81×382 ≈ 4,500 Pa ≈ 45 hPa。若把變化率控制在約 1.26 hPa/s，45 hPa 要分散在約 36 s 內完成。數值為教學估算，台北 101 公開資料約為 48 hPa。~Pressure change rate dp/dt = ρ·g·v. With ρ = 1.2 kg/m³ and v = 16.8 m/s, dp/dt = 1.2×9.81×16.8 ≈ 198 Pa/s ≈ 2.0 hPa/s; rising 382 m gives ρgh = 1.2×9.81×382 ≈ 4,500 Pa ≈ 45 hPa. Holding the rate near 1.26 hPa/s spreads 45 hPa over about 36 s. Teaching estimate; public Taipei 101 data give about 48 hPa.
units.verify: 依 ISO 18738-1 以三軸加速度計與麥克風量測車廂乘坐品質，記錄最大加減速度、加加速度、水平與垂直振動及噪音，並以氣壓計記錄車廂內壓力變化率；導軌安裝後以雷射或鋼線檢查直線度與接頭段差，結果與規格比較。~Measure ride quality to ISO 18738-1 with a triaxial accelerometer and microphone, recording peak acceleration, jerk, horizontal and vertical vibration and noise, and log the cabin pressure change rate with a barometer; after rail installation, check straightness and joint steps with a laser or plumb wire and compare with the specification.
units.failure: 導軌接頭段差或支架鬆動會在固定高度產生週期性橫向衝擊，乘客感到「卡一下」，主動導靴長期飽和後滾輪與軸承加速磨耗；壓力控制失效時耳痛投訴增加，營運者常被迫降速運轉。~A rail joint step or loose bracket causes a periodic lateral knock at the same height that passengers feel as a jolt; active guides that run saturated for long periods wear their rollers and bearings faster, and when pressure control fails ear-pain complaints rise and operators are often forced to run at reduced speed.
units.misconception: 超高速電梯上行與下行一定以相同的最高速度運轉。~An ultra-high-speed elevator always runs at the same top speed up and down.
units.practice: 在規範中把乘坐品質寫成可量測的驗收值（振動、噪音、壓力變化率），並為導軌安裝設保留點：導軌直線度檢查完成並經監造簽認前，不得安裝車廂與門系統。~Write ride quality into the specification as measurable acceptance values (vibration, noise, pressure-change rate) and set a hold point for rail installation: no car or door equipment may be installed until rail straightness has been checked and signed off by the supervising engineer.

units.anchor: 導軌滑動支架~Sliding rail brackets
units.title: 核心筒縮短與施工期電梯~Core shortening and construction-phase lifts
units.mechanism: 超高層核心筒以爬模逐層上升，電梯井道在結構仍在施工時就得開始安裝，許多專案還用可隨結構爬升的施工期電梯（例如 KONE JumpLift）提早載運工人。混凝土核心筒在自重、潛變與乾縮下會持續縮短，鋼導軌卻不會，所以導軌必須以允許垂直滑動的支架固定，並在導軌接頭與頂部預留伸縮量；施工期的風致擺動與日照溫差也讓井道垂直度量測必須選在穩定時段進行。~A supertall core rises floor by floor on climbing forms, and hoistway installation must start while the structure is still being built; many projects also run construction lifts that climb with the structure, such as KONE JumpLift, to move workers early. The concrete core keeps shortening under self-weight, creep and shrinkage while the steel rails do not, so rails are fixed with brackets that allow vertical sliding, and movement allowances are left at rail joints and at the top; wind sway and solar temperature differences during construction also mean hoistway plumb surveys must be taken in stable periods.
units.model: 核心筒長期縮短 ΔL = ε·H。取潛變加乾縮應變 ε = 300×10⁻⁶、井道高度 H = 400 m：ΔL = 300×10⁻⁶×400,000 mm = 120 mm。導軌支架間距 4 m 時，相鄰支架間的相對滑動增量為 300×10⁻⁶×4,000 mm = 1.2 mm；若導軌固定於底部，頂部支架累積滑動 120 mm。數值為教學假設。~Long-term core shortening ΔL = ε·H. With creep plus shrinkage strain ε = 300×10⁻⁶ and hoistway height H = 400 m, ΔL = 300×10⁻⁶×400,000 mm = 120 mm. With rail brackets every 4 m the slip increment between neighbouring brackets is 300×10⁻⁶×4,000 mm = 1.2 mm; if the rail is fixed at the bottom, the top bracket accumulates 120 mm of slip. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以鉛垂雷射或垂線在井道內設基準線，每隔數層量測井道牆面與基準線距離，確認淨尺寸與垂直度；並與結構設計者提供的預測縮短量比較，在導軌安裝後第一年內複測支架滑動量與導軌接頭間隙。~Set reference lines in the hoistway with plumb lasers or wires, measure wall offsets every few floors to confirm clear dimensions and plumbness, compare with the structural designer's predicted shortening, and re-measure bracket slip and rail joint gaps during the first year after rail installation.
units.failure: 導軌若以固定支架鎖死在核心筒上，核心縮短會把導軌壓彎或在接頭處擠出段差，造成車廂振動甚至導靴卡滯；井道垂直度量測若選在日照不均的下午，可能把結構暫時的熱彎曲當成施工偏差而錯誤修正。~Rails clamped rigidly to the core are bowed or pushed into joint steps as the core shortens, causing car vibration or even jammed guides; plumb surveys taken on unevenly sunlit afternoons can mistake temporary thermal bending of the structure for construction error and lead to wrong corrections.
units.misconception: 鋼導軌只要安裝時完全垂直，日後就不需要考慮結構變形。~Steel rails installed perfectly plumb need no allowance for later structural movement.
units.practice: 機電與結構顧問應共同出具井道變形預算，列出縮短、擺動與溫度變形量，作為導軌支架形式與調整範圍的依據；施工期電梯的使用、爬升與移交程序須經業主、電梯公司與檢查機構三方確認。~The lift and structural consultants should jointly issue a hoistway movement budget listing shortening, sway and thermal deformation as the basis for bracket type and adjustment range; use, climbing and handover of construction-phase lifts must be agreed among the owner, the lift company and the inspection body.

units.anchor: 目的樓層登錄面板~Destination entry panels
units.title: 目的樓層派梯與群控演算法~Destination dispatch and group-control algorithms
units.mechanism: 傳統群控在乘客進入車廂後才知道目的地，同一部車往往在許多樓層停靠。目的樓層派梯讓乘客在大廳先輸入樓層，系統把前往相近樓層的人分到同一部車，因此每趟停靠次數減少、往返時間縮短、尖峰運輸能力提高；代價是乘客要依指示走到指定電梯，候梯時間可能略增，但到達目的地時間通常縮短。演算法還能依時段切換上行尖峰、午餐雙向與下行模式，並保留無障礙或特殊用途的分派規則。~Conventional group control learns a passenger's destination only after boarding, so one car often stops at many floors. Destination dispatch has passengers enter their floor in the lobby and groups people bound for nearby floors into the same car, so each trip makes fewer stops, the round trip shortens and peak handling capacity rises; the price is that passengers must walk to the assigned car and waiting time may rise slightly, while time to destination usually falls. The algorithm can also switch between up-peak, two-way lunch and down-peak modes and keep special assignment rules for accessibility or other uses.
units.model: 可能停靠數 S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P]。一般群控 N = 15 層、每趟 P = 16 人：(14/15)^16 ≈ 0.332，S ≈ 15×0.668 ≈ 10.0 站。若派梯把每部車限制在約 5 層：(4/5)^16 ≈ 0.028，S ≈ 5×0.972 ≈ 4.9 站。每站損失時間取 10 s，每趟約節省 (10.0−4.9)×10 ≈ 51 s。數值為教學假設。~Probable stops S = N[1 − (1 − 1/N)^P]. With conventional control, N = 15 floors and P = 16 passengers per trip: (14/15)^16 ≈ 0.332 and S ≈ 15×0.668 ≈ 10.0 stops. If dispatch limits each car to about 5 floors: (4/5)^16 ≈ 0.028 and S ≈ 5×0.972 ≈ 4.9 stops. At 10 s lost per stop each trip saves about (10.0−4.9)×10 ≈ 51 s. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試運轉時以派梯系統的事件紀錄（登錄時間、分派車號、上車與到達時間）計算候梯時間與到達目的地時間分布，與模擬預測的平均值及 95 百分位比較；並實地觀察乘客是否看得懂指示、是否有人搭錯車而造成多餘停靠。~During commissioning, compute distributions of waiting time and time to destination from the dispatch system's event log (registration time, assigned car, boarding and arrival times) and compare averages and 95th percentiles with the simulation; also observe on site whether passengers understand the signs and whether wrong boardings cause extra stops.
units.failure: 登錄面板位置不當或指示不清時，乘客會在車廂內再按樓層或搭上非指派車輛，系統的分組假設被打亂，停靠數回升；若只有大廳採目的樓層登錄而上層仍用傳統按鈕，混合模式設定錯誤也會讓午餐尖峰表現比舊系統更差。~Badly placed panels or unclear signs lead passengers to press buttons inside the car or board unassigned cars, upsetting the grouping and pushing stop counts back up; when only the lobby uses destination entry while upper floors keep conventional buttons, a wrongly configured hybrid mode can make lunch-peak performance worse than the old system.
units.misconception: 目的樓層派梯一定會讓每位乘客的候梯時間變短。~Destination dispatch always shortens every passenger's waiting time.
units.practice: 派梯參數（尖峰模式時段、分組上限、無障礙登錄、緊急模式）應以書面設定表交接，並在入住率約一半與接近滿租時各調校一次；任何參數修改都要記錄日期與理由。~Hand over dispatch parameters (peak-mode periods, grouping limits, accessible registration, emergency modes) as a written settings table, retune once at about half occupancy and again near full occupancy, and log the date and reason for every parameter change.

units.title: 往返時間計算與交通模擬~Round-trip-time calculation and traffic simulation
units.mechanism: 傳統上行尖峰計算把一部電梯的一個循環拆成：在大廳載客、往上行駛到最高反轉樓層、途中各站開關門與乘客進出、再空車回到大廳。往返時間除以電梯台數得到平均間隔，車廂人數乘以 300 s 再除以往返時間得到每部車的五分鐘運輸量。公式假設乘客均勻到達、樓層需求平均，並不適用於雙層車廂、超過約 200 m 的行程或轉乘系統，ISO 8100-32 也明列這些排除項，因此超高層須以蒙地卡羅交通模擬補足。~The classic up-peak calculation breaks one car cycle into loading at the lobby, travelling up to the highest reversal floor, opening and closing doors and transferring passengers at each stop, then returning empty to the lobby. Round-trip time divided by the number of cars gives the average interval, and car load times 300 s divided by round-trip time gives the five-minute capacity of each car. The formula assumes uniform arrivals and evenly spread demand, so it does not fit double-deck cars, travel beyond about 200 m or transfer systems; ISO 8100-32 lists these exclusions explicitly, so supertall towers supplement it with Monte Carlo traffic simulation.
units.model: RTT = 2H·t_v + (S+1)·t_s + 2P·t_p。取 N = 15、P = 16、最高反轉層 H ≈ 14.5、S ≈ 10.0、每層行駛 t_v = 1.0 s、每站損失 t_s = 10 s、每人進出 t_p = 1.2 s：RTT = 29.1+110.3+38.4 ≈ 178 s。6 部車 HC5 = 300×16×6/178 ≈ 162 人（1,800 人的 9.0%）；8 部車約 216 人（12.0%），間隔 178/8 ≈ 22 s。數值為教學假設。~RTT = 2H·t_v + (S+1)·t_s + 2P·t_p. With N = 15, P = 16, highest reversal floor H ≈ 14.5, S ≈ 10.0, t_v = 1.0 s per floor, t_s = 10 s per stop and t_p = 1.2 s per passenger: RTT = 29.1+110.3+38.4 ≈ 178 s. Six cars give HC5 = 300×16×6/178 ≈ 162 persons (9.0% of 1,800); eight cars give about 216 (12.0%) with an interval of 178/8 ≈ 22 s. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 同一方案以計算法與至少一種模擬工具各算一次，若兩者差異超過約一成就追查假設（車門時間、加減速度、乘客到達分布）；完工後實測車門開關時間、樓層間行駛時間與乘客進出時間，回填模型重算，確認結果仍符合設計目標。~Run each option once by calculation and once in at least one simulation tool; if they differ by more than about a tenth, trace the assumptions (door times, acceleration, arrival distribution). After completion, measure actual door open and close times, floor-to-floor flight times and passenger transfer times, feed them back into the model and confirm the result still meets the design targets.
units.failure: 若假設車門開關 4 s，實際因安全光幕與門速設定變成 6 s，每趟 11 次停靠就多出約 22 s，往返時間增加超過一成，原本剛好達標的分區在入住後立即不足；只看平均值也會忽略最差 5% 乘客的長時間候梯。~If door operation was assumed at 4 s but light-curtain and door-speed settings make it 6 s, a trip with 11 stops gains about 22 s and the round trip grows by more than a tenth, so a zone that just met its target falls short as soon as it is occupied; looking only at averages also hides the long waits of the worst 5% of passengers.
units.misconception: 往返時間公式可以直接套用在雙層車廂與數百公尺的直達穿梭電梯。~The round-trip-time formula applies directly to double-deck cars and shuttles travelling hundreds of metres.
units.practice: 交通分析報告須列出所有輸入參數與來源、計算與模擬兩種結果、候梯時間與到達目的地時間的分布圖，並由獨立的垂直運輸顧問複核；電梯合約應把車門時間與樓層行駛時間列為可量測的驗收項目。~The traffic report must list every input and its source, both calculated and simulated results and distributions of waiting time and time to destination, and be reviewed by an independent vertical-transport consultant; the lift contract should make door times and floor-to-floor flight times measurable acceptance items.

units.title: 建築風擺下的鋼索擺動與管制運轉~Rope sway under building sway and controlled operation
units.mechanism: 超高層在強風下以約 0.1 至 0.2 Hz 的低頻擺動，而數百公尺長的懸吊鋼索與補償索就像長弦，橫向自然頻率也落在相近範圍。兩者頻率接近時，井道頂部的微小擺動會把鋼索激成大幅擺動，鋼索可能碰撞井道設備、纏住感測器或在輪槽中跳槽。電梯系統因此接收建築擺動感測器訊號，超過門檻時自動降速，或把車廂停在使鋼索自由長度避開共振的位置。~A supertall tower sways at low frequency, around 0.1 to 0.2 Hz, in strong wind, while suspension and compensation ropes hundreds of metres long behave like long strings whose transverse natural frequencies fall in a similar range. When the two frequencies approach each other, small motion at the top of the hoistway can drive the ropes into large swings that strike hoistway equipment, snag sensors or jump sheave grooves. The lift system therefore takes signals from building-sway sensors and, above a threshold, slows down automatically or parks cars where the free rope length avoids resonance.
units.model: 弦振動 f = (1/2L)·√(T/m)。取單條鋼索張力 T = 14,000 N、線密度 m = 0.9 kg/m：√(T/m) = √15,556 ≈ 124.7 m/s。自由長度 L = 400 m 時 f ≈ 124.7/800 ≈ 0.156 Hz；若建築頻率為 0.14 Hz，共振長度 L = 124.7/(2×0.14) ≈ 445 m。數值為教學假設。~String vibration f = (1/2L)·√(T/m). With rope tension T = 14,000 N and linear density m = 0.9 kg/m, √(T/m) = √15,556 ≈ 124.7 m/s. A free length L = 400 m gives f ≈ 124.7/800 ≈ 0.156 Hz; if the building frequency is 0.14 Hz the resonant length is L = 124.7/(2×0.14) ≈ 445 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在建築頂部設加速度計或位移計，與井道內鋼索擺動感測器同步記錄並對照風速；試運轉時以模擬訊號測試管制運轉邏輯（降速、停靠樓層、復駛條件），強風事件後檢查鋼索、補償索與井道設備是否有碰撞痕跡。~Record accelerometers or displacement sensors at the top of the building together with rope-sway sensors in the hoistway and wind speed; during commissioning test the controlled-operation logic (speed reduction, parking floors, restart conditions) with simulated signals, and after strong-wind events inspect ropes, compensation ropes and hoistway equipment for contact marks.
units.failure: 若未設擺動管制，颱風後鋼索可能纏繞井道內的限位開關或電纜，電梯停駛數日；反之門檻設得太低，一般強風就讓全部高區電梯降速，風季的尖峰運輸能力大幅下降。~Without sway control, ropes may wrap around limit switches or cables in the hoistway after a typhoon and keep the lifts out of service for days; conversely, a threshold set too low makes every high-zone lift slow down in ordinary strong wind and cuts peak handling capacity throughout the windy season.
units.misconception: 鋼索擺動只與電梯速度有關，與建築擺動無關。~Rope sway depends only on elevator speed, not on building sway.
units.practice: 把建築第一、二模態頻率與阻尼器資料交給電梯公司做鋼索共振分析，並在營運手冊寫明擺動門檻、管制模式與復駛前巡檢項目；須由維修主管確認巡檢完成後才能解除管制復駛。~Give the building's first and second modal frequencies and damper data to the lift company for rope-resonance analysis, and write sway thresholds, controlled modes and pre-restart inspection items into the operating manual; normal service is released only after the maintenance supervisor confirms that the inspection is complete.

units.anchor: 曳引輪槽與彎曲次數~Sheave grooves and bending cycles
units.title: 鋼索磨耗、保養與現代化更新~Rope wear, maintenance and modernisation
units.mechanism: 鋼索每次繞過曳引輪與導向輪都會反覆彎曲，鋼絲在輪槽接觸處逐漸磨耗並出現斷絲；繞輪次數最多的那段鋼索決定整組更換時機。輪槽磨耗會使各條鋼索的有效直徑不同、張力不均，又加速磨耗，所以鋼索與輪槽要一起評估。超高層電梯使用強度高、停機代價大，業主通常在十多年後依控制系統、曳引機與鋼索狀態分階段現代化，例如 Otis 於 2024 年取得更新哈里發塔 57 部電梯中 34 部的合約。~Each pass over the traction and deflector sheaves bends the rope again, wearing the wires where they touch the groove until wires break; the rope section that passes over sheaves most often sets the replacement time for the whole set. Groove wear makes the effective diameters of ropes differ and their tensions uneven, which accelerates wear further, so ropes and grooves must be assessed together. Supertall lifts work hard and downtime is costly, so owners usually modernise in phases after a decade or more according to the condition of controllers, machines and ropes; in 2024, for example, Otis won a contract to modernise 34 of the 57 elevators in Burj Khalifa.
units.model: 彎曲次數 = 每日運轉趟數 × 每趟繞輪次數 × 365。每日 400 趟、每趟繞過曳引輪與導向輪共 2 次：400×2×365 = 292,000 次/年。若教學假設鋼索壽命為 3,000,000 次彎曲，約 3,000,000/292,000 ≈ 10.3 年；改為雙繞式（每趟 4 次彎曲）時壽命約減半為 5.1 年。數值為教學假設。~Bending cycles = daily trips × bends per trip × 365. With 400 trips a day and two bends per trip over the traction and deflector sheaves, 400×2×365 = 292,000 cycles per year. With a teaching rope life of 3,000,000 bends this gives about 3,000,000/292,000 ≈ 10.3 years; a double-wrap layout with four bends per trip roughly halves that to 5.1 years. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期以目視、量規與電磁探傷檢查鋼索的斷絲數、直徑減少與腐蝕，並以輪槽量規檢查槽形磨耗；依鋼索位置把結果記錄成趨勢圖，與製造商的汰換判準比較。遠端監控資料（啟動次數、煞車次數、異常停車）可用來預判下一次檢查重點。~Periodically inspect ropes visually, with gauges and by magnetic flaw detection for broken wires, diameter loss and corrosion, and check groove wear with groove gauges; plot the results as trends by rope position and compare with the manufacturer's discard criteria. Remote-monitoring data (starts, brake applications, unplanned stops) helps predict where the next inspection should focus.
units.failure: 只換鋼索而不修整或更換磨耗輪槽，新鋼索在舊槽中受力不均，短時間內又出現斷絲；鋼索潤滑不足或處於沿海鹽霧環境時，內部腐蝕從外表看不出來，可能在檢查間隔內突然劣化。~Replacing ropes without re-machining or renewing worn grooves loads the new ropes unevenly in the old grooves so broken wires reappear quickly; with poor lubrication or coastal salt air, internal corrosion invisible from outside can degrade a rope suddenly between inspections.
units.misconception: 鋼索外觀沒有斷絲，就代表內部狀況良好。~A rope with no visible broken wires is sound inside.
units.practice: 維護合約應要求逐台建立鋼索與輪槽檔案並規定電磁探傷頻率；現代化計畫要分批停機，確保每個分區在任何時候都保留足夠台數維持尖峰服務。~The maintenance contract should require a rope-and-groove record for every lift and set the frequency of magnetic testing, and the modernisation plan should take lifts out in batches so every zone always keeps enough cars to sustain peak service.

units.anchor: 消防與避難電梯~Firefighter and evacuation lifts
units.title: 緊急運轉、避難電梯與交接~Emergency operation, evacuation lifts and handover
units.mechanism: 超高層的樓梯疏散距離可達數百公尺，行動不便者與高樓層人員單靠樓梯需要很長時間。消防電梯依 EN 81-72 一類規範提供具防火、防水與專用電源的電梯供消防人員使用；部分超高層更把穿梭電梯設計成火災時可由避難層或空中大廳分批接運的避難電梯。這要求井道加壓、電源與控制備援、機電設備防水，並在交接時把各種緊急模式的操作權責寫清楚。~Stair evacuation in a supertall tower can span hundreds of metres, so people with limited mobility and occupants on high floors need a long time to escape by stairs alone. Firefighter lifts to standards such as EN 81-72 provide fire- and water-protected lifts with dedicated power for fire services, and some supertall towers design their shuttles as evacuation lifts that move people in batches from refuge floors or sky lobbies during a fire. This requires pressurised shafts, redundant power and controls and water-protected equipment, and at handover the responsibilities for operating each emergency mode must be written down clearly.
units.model: 樓梯：垂直距離 400 m、垂直下降速度約 0.25 m/s，無壅塞時 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min。穿梭電梯：8 部雙層車各載 48 人，每循環 384 人；從 300 m 避難層往返 2×(300/10+10)+60 = 140 s；2,000 人需 2,000/384 ≈ 5.2，取 6 循環，約 6×140 = 840 s = 14 min。數值為教學假設。~Stairs: 400 m of vertical descent at about 0.25 m/s vertical speed takes 400/0.25 = 1,600 s ≈ 27 min without congestion. Shuttles: eight double-deck cars carrying 48 people each move 384 per cycle; a round trip from a refuge floor at 300 m takes 2×(300/10+10)+60 = 140 s; 2,000 people need 2,000/384 ≈ 5.2, so six cycles, about 6×140 = 840 s = 14 min. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 完工前做整合消防測試：觸發火警後確認電梯依程序返回指定樓層、消防員開關與通話有效、備用電源切換時間符合規範、井道加壓維持設計壓差；並在演練中記錄避難電梯的實際循環時間，與疏散策略的計算比較。~Before completion run an integrated fire test: after a fire alarm, confirm lifts recall to the designated floors, firefighter switches and intercoms work, standby power transfers within the specified time and shaft pressurisation holds the design pressure difference; record actual evacuation-lift cycle times in drills and compare them with the evacuation-strategy calculation.
units.failure: 消防電梯前室若防水或排水不足，消防射水流入井道會使電氣設備短路，電梯在最需要時停擺；交接文件缺少緊急模式說明時，管理人員可能在事件中誤操作，把電梯送往起火樓層。~If the firefighter-lift lobby lacks water protection or drainage, firefighting water entering the shaft can short the electrical equipment and stop the lift when it is most needed; when handover documents omit emergency-mode instructions, building staff may mis-operate lifts during an incident and send them toward the fire floor.
units.misconception: 火災時建築內所有電梯一律不能使用，連消防人員也不例外。~In a fire no lift in the building may be used, not even by firefighters.
units.practice: 交接時提供緊急運轉矩陣：每種事件（火警、停電、地震、強風）下各組電梯的動作、操作人與復歸條件，並安排與消防機關的聯合演練；任何避難電梯策略都須取得主管消防機關核准。~At handover provide an emergency-operation matrix stating, for each event (fire alarm, power failure, earthquake, strong wind), what each lift group does, who operates it and the conditions for return to service, and hold joint drills with the fire service; any evacuation-lift strategy must be approved by the authority having jurisdiction for fire safety.

example: 設計練習：上段 30 層、每層淨面積 1,600 m²、每人 10 m²、出勤率 85%，人口 30×1,600/10×0.85 = 4,080 人；穿梭電梯須在五分鐘運送 13%，即 0.13×4,080 ≈ 530 人。採雙層車廂，每層車廂載 21 人，每趟 42 人；直達行程 250 m、速度 8 m/s、加速度 1.0 m/s²、加加速度 1.0 m/s³，單程時間 t = D/v + v/a + a/j = 31.25+8+1 = 40.25 s。往返時間 = 2×40.25 + 12 s 開關門 + 42 s 上下客 ≈ 134.5 s；每部五分鐘運量 300×42/134.5 ≈ 93.7 人，需 530/93.7 ≈ 5.7，取 6 部，間隔 134.5/6 ≈ 22.4 s。若速度提高到 10 m/s，單程 25+10+1 = 36 s、往返 126 s、每部 100 人，仍需 5.3 部，即 6 部：提速每趟只省約 8.5 s，台數不變，雙層化與縮短上下客時間反而更有效。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築的設計。~Design exercise: an upper tier of 30 floors with 1,600 m² net per floor, 10 m² per person and 85% attendance holds 30×1,600/10×0.85 = 4,080 people; the shuttles must move 13% in five minutes, 0.13×4,080 ≈ 530 people. Using double-deck cars with 21 passengers per deck, each trip carries 42. Express travel of 250 m at 8 m/s with acceleration 1.0 m/s² and jerk 1.0 m/s³ gives a one-way time t = D/v + v/a + a/j = 31.25+8+1 = 40.25 s. Round trip = 2×40.25 + 12 s of door operation + 42 s of passenger transfer ≈ 134.5 s; each car moves 300×42/134.5 ≈ 93.7 people per five minutes, so 530/93.7 ≈ 5.7 and six shuttles are needed, with an interval of 134.5/6 ≈ 22.4 s. Raising speed to 10 m/s gives 25+10+1 = 36 s one way, a 126 s round trip and 100 people per car, still 5.3 and therefore six cars: the extra speed saves only about 8.5 s per trip and does not change the car count, while double-decking and faster passenger transfer do more. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real building.
history: 1854 年 Elisha Otis 在紐約水晶宮展示安全煞車，使載人電梯得以普及，高樓從此能往上發展。1960 至 1970 年代興建的原世界貿易中心雙塔把每棟分成三段，以 44 與 78 樓空中大廳轉乘，確立超高層「直達穿梭加區間電梯」的分區模式；1990 年 Schindler 推出 Miconic 10 目的樓層派梯系統，把派梯決策移到乘客進入車廂之前。2000 年代之後，台北 101、上海中心大廈與廣州周大福金融中心相繼刷新電梯速度紀錄，碳纖維曳引索則挑戰單段行程限制。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~In 1854 Elisha Otis demonstrated his safety brake at the New York Crystal Palace, making passenger lifts acceptable and letting buildings grow taller. The original World Trade Center towers, built in the 1960s and 1970s, split each tower into three tiers with sky lobbies on floors 44 and 78, establishing the supertall pattern of express shuttles plus local elevators; in 1990 Schindler launched Miconic 10, a destination-control system that moved the dispatch decision to before passengers board. Since the 2000s Taipei 101, Shanghai Tower and Guangzhou CTF Finance Centre have each set elevator speed records, and carbon-fibre hoisting ropes have challenged the single-run travel limit. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
